messages:
maria: hey all — just finished initial company image on my MacBook Air (M2). Kandji shows the device enrolled but "Supervision: No" and i get a "System extension blocked" dialog for our wifi driver. also FileVault says off locally and Kandji shows "No FV escrow". i can’t install the corp wifi cert or accept the kernel extension. can someone help with temporary elevation or a remote assist? :wave:

it-jordan: welcome maria. can you paste the serial (apple menu > About) and run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`? we try to avoid long-lived admin access but can give a short-lived temp admin.

maria: serial C02XTR12345A. `profiles` prints: "No enrolled profiles." `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off." system dialog text references com.broadcom.wifi.

mdm-ops: thanks — looks like supervision didn't finalize after DEP/ABM enrollment (DEP token hiccup last night). i'll re-trigger the supervision assignment and push a refresh. i'll also grant temporary admin for 60 minutes while we sort this. please don't reboot until i say so. ETA ~10-15m.

enrollment-bot: Job queued: enable_supervision -> device=C02XTR12345A (job=49832)

enrollment-bot: Job started: enable_supervision -> device=C02XTR12345A (job=49832)

enrollment-bot: Job completed: enable_supervision -> success (supervision=true) (job=49832)

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_supervision_profiles_49832 -> device=C02XTR12345A
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_supervision_profiles_49832 -> success (profiles installed)

maria: i got a new prompt in System Preferences > Security & Privacy to allow the network extension, clicked Allow. `fdesetup status` now: "FileVault is On." Kandji still says "Escrow pending."

mdm-ops: pushing FileVault escrow script and corp wifi cert now. also added your ssh pubkey to the device profile so it will land at `/Users/maria/.ssh/authorized_keys`. mdm-bot will post when deployments finish.

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_fv_escrow_49833 -> device=C02XTR12345A
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_fv_escrow_49833 -> success (fv_key_escrowed)

mdm-bot: Deployment started: push_wifi_cert_49834 -> device=C02XTR12345A
mdm-bot: Deployment completed: push_wifi_cert_49834 -> success (wifi_cert_installed)

maria: wifi now connects fine, ssh key present, and i can install homebrew. thanks! :white_check_mark:

it-jordan: leaving the 60-min temp admin active. when you're done reply here and we'll revoke. filing follow-up to rotate DEP token to reduce these hits.

maria: removed test packages and dev certs. all set from my side — please remove the temp admin. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

mdm-ops: temp admin revoked for maria (user removed from /etc/sudoers.d/company-temp-admins). closing this thread and creating a ticket to monitor DEP token refresh cadence.
